headline: Cadilla Summit Road and Acadia Entry Requirements
reservation: An Acadia entrance pass is required for all visitors. During peak seasons, driving the Cadillac Summit Road requires a separate vehicle reservation booked through official channels. This system is distinct from lodging; verify both entry and summit access on the official NPS site, as systems may change.

days.title: Coastal Granite and Ocean Vistas

stops.name: Ocean Path
stops.detail: Walk the scenic coastline from Sand Beach toward Thunder Hole to observe the force of the Atlantic against granite cliffs.

stops.name: Jordan Pond
stops.detail: Explore the shoreline trail for views of the North and South Bubbles reflected in clear glacial waters.

days.driving: Allow 1-2 hours for the Park Loop Road; traffic and parking searches vary significantly by season.
days.note: Portions of Park Loop Road are one-way; map your route to avoid long bypasses.

days.title: Tides and Town Exploration

stops.name: Bar Island
stops.detail: Cross the natural gravel land bridge at low tide for a unique view back toward the town skyline.

stops.name: Agamont Park
stops.detail: Relax on the grassy hills overlooking the harbor to watch the local fishing and excursion fleet.

days.driving: Minimal; these sites are accessible by walking from central Bar Harbor.
days.note: Bar Island access is strictly tide-dependent; check official tide tables to avoid being stranded.

days.title: Summit Views and Island Heritage

stops.name: Cadillac Mountain
stops.detail: Visit the highest point on the U.S. Atlantic coast for panoramic views of the Porcupine Islands.

stops.name: Sieur de Monts
stops.detail: Discover the 'Heart of Acadia' featuring the Wild Gardens and historical springs.

days.driving: Allow 1 hour for the summit drive; conditions and visibility vary.
days.note: Vehicle reservations are required for Cadillac Summit during peak months.

intel.title: Village and Trailhead Capacity
intel.text: Parking at popular trailheads like Sand Beach often reaches capacity by mid-morning. Utilize the Island Explorer bus service when operating to reach park destinations from town.

intel.title: Connectivity on Mount Desert Island
intel.text: Cellular service is inconsistent within Acadia's valleys and along the western side of the island. Download offline maps and official park apps before leaving Bar Harbor.

intel.title: Gateway Supplies
intel.text: Fuel stations are located in Bar Harbor and nearby Ellsworth, but no gasoline is sold inside Acadia National Park. Ensure your tank is sufficient for the Park Loop Road circuit.

intel.title: Seasonal Road Closures
intel.text: The majority of Park Loop Road closes to vehicles from December through mid-April. Check the official park website for specific gate opening dates in the spring.

intel.title: Shore Path Limitations
intel.text: The historic Shore Path may experience periodic closures due to storm damage or maintenance. Confirm current access status at the town information center near Agamont Park.

plan.arrival: Pick up your vehicle at Hancock County-Bar Harbor Airport (BHB) and head to Ellsworth for groceries and supplies before crossing the bridge to Mount Desert Island.
plan.vehicle: Standard cars are suitable for paved park roads; check rental agreements for restrictions on unpaved private ways.
plan.goldenHour: Cadillac Mountain Summit is a premier viewpoint, but sunrise visibility is highly dependent on coastal fog.
